app.name: Vibe Build
mode.line: Scripted mode: no AI model is connected. The real-model gate is closed.
simulated.note: Fixed content written in advance by Claude Code (the AI assistant building this project); no model call by the builder.
sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.footnote: Single-user sign-in for a prototype. Not single sign-on, not hardened.
sign_in.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Sign-in is locked for {seconds} seconds.
setup.title: Choose your password
setup.intro: This interface has no password yet. The first person to reach this page sets it. Use 12 characters or more.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.too_short: The password must be 12 characters or more.
setup.already: The password is already set. Sign in.
setup.done: Password set. Sign in with it.
projects.title: Projects
projects.others: Projects made outside this interface are not shown: {n}.
col.name: Name
new.title: New project
new.name: Project name
new.cap_help: The most this project may spend on model calls. Scripted steps spend $0, but each step must fit its reservation.
new.made_up: Made-up data only. No customer or personal details.
brief.title: Your brief
brief.simulated_analyst: Simulated analyst: fixed questions for test example 1 (leave requests). It does not read your brief; every brief continues as example 1. A real analyst needs the model key (milestone 2).
brief.stopped: This project is stopped. Nothing more happens to it.
questions.title: Questions
questions.something_else_help: Type it here. It is logged as a sign that an option is missing.
questions.their_call: Their call: only you can answer this, so nothing is recommended.
questions.recorded_verbatim: Recorded word for word; nothing is recommended.
questions.fields_note: The fields are the app spec's, in English.
questions.scripted_customer: Answer the rest from example 1's answer sheet (scripted customer)
questions.differs: Recorded. The scripted build always builds example 1's answers.
questions.by_sheet: Answered by the scripted customer, from example 1's answer sheet.
questions.not_yet: The questions start once you continue with example 1.
proposal.title: Proposed app
proposal.in_english: The app spec of example 1 is written in English; its content is shown as written.
proposal.confirm_sentence: Confirm this brief, or tell me what to change. Nothing is built until you confirm.
proposal.no_change: Changing the brief is not available in scripted mode: the build is always example 1.
proposal.not_yet: The proposed app is shown once every question is answered.
plan.title: Build steps
plan.not_built: Not built in scripted mode: team queue, HR table, approve, reject, withdraw, balance. Checklist items 2 to 6 cannot pass.
plan.quality_gate: Quality gate after each step: not done (milestone 1).
plan.tests_fixed: Confirming the plan fixes the checklist's tests. They are stand-in tests, not independent acceptance.
plan.confirmed: Plan confirmed. Tests fixed as version {version}: stand-in test, not independent acceptance.
plan.not_yet: The build steps are shown once the brief is confirmed.
record.title: Record
record.order: Every event of this project, in the order it was written (event number), not by clock time.
cost.title: Cost
cost.read_only: Read-only. Changing the cap is a recorded change Claude Code makes when you ask.
cost.held: Held for calls in progress or awaiting reconciliation
cost.zero: Spent: $0.00. No model was called. This is not the cost of a real build.
cost.no_steps: No step has been reserved yet.
cost.frozen_intro: This project is frozen: no step starts until each freeze below is cleared by the owner's recorded action.
cost.freeze_message: Message, as the gateway's refusal gives it
cost.kind.unrecorded_ending: A call's ending could not be recorded
cost.kind.late_answer_above_hold: A late answer above its hold
cost.kind.kept_above_hold: A call kept with usage already above its hold
cost.kind.journal_line_set_aside: An unreadable journal line set aside
cost.overrun: A bill above its hold (freeze {freeze}): billed {bill}, held {held}, above it by {above}. Charged in full; cleared by the owner's record of that bill.
cost.priced: Step reservations are sized at {model}'s prices, from the price table of {date}.
interrupted.message: A job of this project was interrupted when the interface stopped. It is not resumed. Close the project, or start a new one.
error.title: Not done
error.english_only: The reason is given in English.
error.server: Something went wrong. The project's record shows what was written.
job.running: A job is running: {kind}. This page refreshes itself every 2 seconds.
job.kind.preview: building and starting the app for the preview
build.title: Build
build.not_yet: The build starts once the plan is confirmed.
build.intro: Each step runs in its own container, under its own reservation. Nothing goes on to the next step until you approve this one.
build.approve_next: Approve and build the next step
build.approve_last: Approve and start the app for the preview
build.no_preview_after_1: No preview after step 1 in J1: it adds the table and a banner line only. The app is built once, after step 2.
build.disk_note: Before each build the free disk space is measured. A build needs at least {gb} GB free (a floor assumed, not measured).
build.sim_note: Scripted: fixed change, no model call. The container, the history and the reservation are real.
build.step_label: Scripted: fixed change, no model call. Reserved while it ran: {usd}, sized at {model}'s prices, released. Spent: {spent}.
build.refusal_extra: Scripted steps spend $0; this is a reservation sized from a real model's price. To go on, ask Claude Code to change the cap (a recorded change), or start a new project.
build.line.sandbox: Sandbox made: the template copied and its history started. No container yet.
build.line.reserved: Reserved {usd} for up to {turns} turns, sized at {model}'s prices.
build.line.engine_finished: The engine finished; the files were checked and committed.
build.line.refused: Refused before it started: the reservation does not fit the cap.
build.line.reset: The workspace was put back to its last commit.
build.line.job_interrupted: Interrupted: the interface stopped while it ran.
preview.title: Preview
preview.start: Start the app for the preview
preview.failed: The last preview failed. Its containers and images were removed; it can be tried again.
preview.app_running: The app is running in its sandbox on this machine, on the project's own private networks: only the project's own containers reach it. The live app below passes your clicks to it through short-lived containers on those networks.
preview.app_stopped: The app is not running any more.
preview.not_live: The screenshots below were taken by the app camera; they are not live. To use the app yourself, use "Open the live app".
preview.caption: Screenshot of the running app at {time} UTC. Not live. Sample data.
acceptance.title: Checklist
acceptance.run_intro: The acceptance runner runs the fixed tests in its own container, against the running app.
acceptance.outcome: Outcome, as the run's record gives it
acceptance.outcome.none: None recorded: not read as passed
acceptance.summary: Summary, as the runner's reading wrote it
acceptance.not_run: The checklist has not been run yet.
acceptance.running: The checklist is running; its results are shown when it ends.
acceptance.no_run: None: the job ended before the runner recorded a run
acceptance.label: stand-in test, not independent acceptance
acceptance.sim_note: The test was written in advance by Claude Code (the AI assistant building this project), not by the builder's acceptance writer. The run itself is real.
acceptance.no_test: No test written yet: did not run.
acceptance.test_not_run_yet: Its test is written; the checklist has not been run yet.
acceptance.test_no_result: Its test is written; the latest checklist job recorded no result for it.
acceptance.shot_caption: Taken by the acceptance runner at the end of the test. Sample data.
acceptance.sign_off_label: Sign-off on a simulated build, checked by a stand-in test of item 1 only: not acceptance
acceptance.sign_off_not_yet: Sign-off is offered once a checklist run has passed.
export.title: Export
export.not_yet: Export is offered only after sign-off.
export.label: Internal only, not for customers. Not yet shown to start without the builder (package 3.2): its tables are made by the builder's tools container, and it has no notices file.
export.what: A copy of the project's history, with the checklist's tests added in the copy only, as one .tar.gz file.
export.acceptance_copy_only: Version {version}, added in the exported copy only, not in the project's own history.
close.note: Closing removes the project's containers, images and folder. Its record stays.
close.done: This project is closed: its containers, images and folder were removed. Its record stays.
live.title: Live app
live.sim_note: The app was built by the scripted engine: fixed changes written in advance by Claude Code (the AI assistant building this project); no model call by the builder.
live.label_sim: Simulated build: scripted engine, sample data
live.label_data: Made-up data only. No customer or personal details. Removed when the project closes.
live.intro: Use the running app yourself, from your phone: its own sign-in, My requests, a new request, Arabic. The builder passes your clicks to the app through the project's own sandbox; it changes none of the app's pages.
live.not_approved: Not yet approved for use: your two-page phone test comes first (docs/QUESTIONS.md, "Yours to confirm").
live.not_started: The live preview is not running in this interface.
live.only_running: The live app is offered only while this project's app runs.
live.open_again: Open the live app again (a new pass; the open session ends)
live.open_pending: A pass is open until {time} UTC; it has not been used yet.
live.open_entered: The live app is open since {time} UTC, until {until} UTC at the latest. It closes when you leave it, sign out here, run the checklist or close the project.
live.where: Then open "app" in your Claude app's preview list (this machine's port {port}) and type the pass.
live.checklist_note: Running the checklist ends the live app first; the run's record then says the app was used live and its data changed.
live.pass_title: Your pass for the live app
live.pass_valid: It works once, until {time} UTC (2 minutes). Only you should see it.
live.pass_bound: It is tied to this sign-in, this project and this start of the app. It is not recorded anywhere.
live.sample_note: A made-up employee of the sample data, for the app's own sign-in. Shown only when you ask; not recorded.
acceptance.used_live: The app was used live before this run; its data changed.
front.title: Live app
front.label_sim: Simulated build: scripted engine, sample data
front.label_data: Made-up data only. No customer or personal details. Removed when the project closes.
front.no_live: No live app now. On the builder's preview screen, press "Open the live app" while the app runs.
front.pass_help: Type the pass the builder showed after "Open the live app". It works once, for 2 minutes.
front.locked: Too many wrong passes. The pass is void and this page is closed for {seconds} seconds; then ask the builder for a new pass.
front.no_pass: No pass is open now, or it has expired or been used. Press "Open the live app" on the builder for a new one.
front.refused: This was not passed to the app: {reason}.
front.left: You left the live app. Its session is closed.
front.off_site: The app tried to send you to another site. The preview did not follow.
front.not_passed: The app's answer was not passed on: {reason}.
front.too_large: Too large: at most 1 MB is passed to the app.
demo.title: Simulated build
demo.intro: Builds example 1 with one more step that Claude Code broke on purpose: a new request is saved as Approved instead of Waiting. The steps are fixed changes written in advance; no AI model is called. The checklist run on it is real. It is never signed off or exported.
demo.sim_note: Fixed changes written in advance by Claude Code (the AI assistant building this project), one of them broken on purpose; no model call by the builder. The checklist run on it is real.
demo.limit: What this shows, and what it does not: Claude Code wrote both the planted defect and the test, each knowing the other. A failed run here shows the checklist's runner rejecting this one defect. It does not show that the checklist catches defects in general.
broken.badge: Deliberately broken copy: a defect Claude Code planted on purpose
broken.step_note: Deliberately broken copy: a new request is saved as Approved instead of Waiting. Made so that the checklist rejects it.
broken.no_quality_check: No quality check after a step yet, and no retry (milestones 1 and 3): only the checklist at the end checks the app.
broken.never_signed_off: A deliberately broken copy is never signed off or exported.
broken.passed_warning: A checklist run passed on a deliberately broken copy: the check did not catch the planted defect. It is still not signed off.
build.approve_broken: Approve and build step {n} (the deliberately broken copy)
build.approve_after_broken: Go on to the preview with this broken step (no quality check after a step yet)
interrupted.no_job: The interface stopped while this project's app was set up or running. Its containers are removed at the stop or at the next start; nothing is resumed. Close the project, or start a new one.
cost.stopped_part_way: stopped part-way when the interface stopped; not resumed
build.step_pause: Demonstration setting: the scripted engine pauses {ms} ms before each write, so that a stop part-way can be shown.
